articles.title: Scientists Say: Occultation
articles.snippet: Thanks to one of these events in 1977, astronomers discovered Uranus's rings.
articles.summary: In 1977, astronomers used a special event called an occultation to discover the rings around the planet Uranus. This type of cosmic event helped scientists learn more about our solar system.

articles.title: Seals long ago evolved to hear above the water — and below
articles.snippet: Spongy tissue that fills with blood makes this possible, show X-ray scans of hundreds of ears from seals and other animals.
articles.summary: X-ray scans of hundreds of animal ears show that seals evolved spongy tissue filled with blood to help them hear both above and below the water. This special tissue makes it possible for seals to hear in both environments.

articles.title: Mystery solved? Why ‘sleeping’ ants suddenly explode with activity
articles.snippet: For decades, scientists have puzzled over what triggers some colonies of ants to burst from rest into community-wide action. Math may now explain this.
articles.summary: Scientists used math to figure out what triggers resting ant colonies to suddenly burst into community-wide action. This solves a decades-long mystery about why sleeping ants suddenly become very active.
